The '''Global Organization of Interstellar Shippers''' was a group made up of representatives of the largest transportation corporations based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Active during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the organization met with representatives of the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' during its visit to the planet in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].

==History==
The Global Organization of Interstellar Shippers was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]], located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="dirp" /> The group was comprised of members of the largest transport corporations from across the world.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|345|Global Organization of Interstellar Shippers}}</ref> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' made a layover at Gandle Ott while in [[DarkStryder Campaign|pursuit]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], a rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. During the second [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} visit, a delegation from the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] command crew met with representatives of the Global Organization of Interstellar Shippers for a luncheon.<ref name="dirp" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Global Organization of Interstellar Shippers was first mentioned in ''[[Death Is Remotely Possible]]'', the third [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] adventure in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. The organization was later mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
